title: Descobrir v1 KnowledgeRecord
description: Generic machine-readable Knowledge Record contract for Descobrir v1. Relations are separate records (see relation.schema.json), never embedded in attributes. Project Profiles narrow type, attributes, and natural-key rules. Storage technology is intentionally unspecified. IDs are unique within namespace. Status comprovado requires at least one verified repository evidence on this record; artifact evidence alone never implies comprovado. Must not contain secrets, env values, connection strings, raw code payloads, absolute paths, or dirty-file contents in summary/attributes.

id.description: Deterministic Canonical ID derived from type + normalized natural_key. Unique within namespace. Excludes machine paths, source_revision, engine identity, and timestamps.

namespace.description: Knowledge Namespace of the owning project. Persistence does not cross namespaces. Generic string; profiles may constrain values.

type.description: Record type as a non-empty string. Closed enumerations belong in Project Profiles, not this generic contract.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Must not be used as Canonical ID.

summary.description: Short factual summary. Narrative compression must not mutate id, attributes, evidence, status, or hashes. Must not embed secrets, env values, connection strings, raw code payloads, absolute paths, or dirty-file contents.

attributes.description: Typed payload bag for profile-specific fields. Keys and value shapes are narrowed by Project Profile; this contract only requires an object. Must not embed secrets, env values, connection strings, raw code payloads, absolute paths, or dirty-file contents. Relations must not be embedded here.

status.description: Source-status of the factual claim (enum value, never a separate flag). comprovado is allowed only when this record's evidence contains a resolvable repository reference verified against source_revision.

source_revision.description: Logical VCS revision at which the fact was observed. Format is engine/VCS-agnostic (not restricted to 40-char hex). v1 records this field; incremental freshness updater is out of scope.

evidence.description: Discriminated evidence list. Repository evidence anchors code truth at pinned revision; artifact evidence anchors what a Discovery Engine emitted. Artifact evidence alone must not yield status comprovado. Each comprovado record must carry its own verified repository evidence.
comprovado requires at least one repository evidence item on this record. Artifact-only evidence is insufficient.

canonicalRecordId.description: Type-prefixed Canonical ID: <type>:<normalized-natural-key>. Non-empty on both sides of the first colon. Unique within namespace.

sourceStatus.description: comprovado: this record has verified repository evidence at source_revision. hipótese: artifact-only or unverified/unresolvable repository evidence. contradição: status (never a flag) for incompatible claims; none promoted canonical. stale: code advanced past source_revision; consumed by later freshness checks; v1 only records source_revision.

name.description: Discovery Engine name as a generic non-empty string. Not a closed enum in this contract.

profile.description: Engine profile name as a generic non-empty string. Narrowed by profiles, not here.

adapter_version.description: Artifact Adapter version that produced this record.

artifact_manifest_id.description: Content-addressed Artifact Manifest id (see artifact-manifest.schema.json). Links the record to the in-place artifact inventory.

relativePath.description: Same strict relativePath constraints as Artifact Manifest entries. Must resolve to a matching manifest artifact path.

lineRange.description: Inclusive 1-based line range. end_line must be >= start_line (enforced by producers; documented in repo-reference.md).

uri.description: Machine-independent Repository Reference per repo-reference.md: repo://<logical>@<revision>/<relative-path>#Lx-Ly. Path segments reject '.', '..', whitespace, backslash, percent-encoding, and reserved characters % ? # @. end_line >= start_line is a producer invariant. Repo and revision remain generic non-empty strings.

manifest_id.description: Artifact Manifest ID that lists the referenced native artifact.

artifact_path.description: Relative path of the artifact within the manifest inventory. Same constraints as manifest entry path. Must resolve to a matching manifest artifact with the same content_sha256. Never an absolute machine path.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the artifact bytes as recorded in the Artifact Manifest (in-place target context).

range.description: Inclusive line range inside the native artifact.

artifactEvidence.description: Exact shape: {kind:"artifact",manifest_id,artifact_path,content_sha256,range}. Proves what a Discovery Engine emitted. Alone, it must not promote status to comprovado.

evidence.description: Discriminated union on kind: repository | artifact.
